0022600207.text: The Indiana Pacers (3-6, 0-4 at home) visit the Dallas Mavericks (5-4) on a one-game win streak, sitting third in the Central at 3.5 games back and 10th in the East. Indiana is without Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain; 21.8 points and 33.0 minutes per game this season), Ben Sheppard (knee) and Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), while Dallas, fourth in the Southwest and 2 games back, is missing Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation). Indiana trails the 2026-27 season series 0-1 after losing 121-105 in Indianapolis on October 23, and the Pacers lost both meetings in 2025-26.
